props.text: Monterrey is a VivaAerobus stronghold, and the Cancún route shows it — one of the carrier's densest routes anywhere, with up to 15 flights a day. Flying out of MTY, a trip to Oaxaca can start around $926 for flight, hotel, and activities together — not just the flight, pulled from our own cost data, not guesses.

features.title: Cancún — nonstop, ~2h10m–2h30m
features.text: VivaAerobus (dominant, ~69 flights/week) and Volaris combine for up to 15 flights a day.

features.title: Oaxaca — nonstop, but thin (~11 flights/week)
features.text: VivaAerobus and Volaris fly it roughly once a day — plan ahead rather than booking last minute.

features.title: Cabo San Lucas — nonstop, ~1h55m–2h05m
features.text: VivaAerobus is the only nonstop carrier, about 2–3 flights a day.

props.text: Monterrey–Cancún is one of VivaAerobus's densest routes system-wide, which keeps fares competitive and gives real schedule flexibility for a last-minute weekend trip. Monterrey's affluent business-travel segment has long favored Cabo San Lucas for golf and resort weekends. Oaxaca's comparatively sparse schedule — a single-digit number of flights a day at most — signals it's booked as a planned trip, not a spontaneous one.

items.question: Are these real-time prices?
items.answer: They're estimates based on our own curated cost data for this route and season, not a live quote — the real price on the partner site may be a bit higher or lower depending on exact dates.

items.question: Is Cancún or Cabo San Lucas faster from Monterrey?
items.answer: Both run roughly 2 to 2.5 hours nonstop, but Cancún has far more daily departures — up to 15 versus 2-3 for Cabo — giving more schedule flexibility and generally sharper fares.

items.question: How often does Monterrey fly to Oaxaca?
items.answer: About once a day nonstop (roughly 11 flights a week) — plan ahead rather than booking last minute.
